name: sdc-data-integrity
description: Structured data introspection, validation, and distribution via SDC Agents SMB. Introspect SQL, CSV, JSON, MongoDB, Notion, Google Sheets, and Airtable datasources. Validate against SDC4 semantic schemas. Download data model packages.
author: Axius SDC, Inc.

tools.name: sdc_introspect_csv
tools.description: Analyze CSV file structure: column types (10 patterns), nullability, sample values, sidecar metadata. Returns standardized 13-field column format.

datasource_name.description: Name of a configured CSV datasource from sdc-agents.yaml

tools.name: sdc_introspect_sql
tools.description: Introspect SQL database schema: columns, types, primary keys, foreign keys, CHECK constraints, defaults. Read-only (SELECT only).

datasource_name.description: Name of a configured SQL datasource

tools.name: sdc_introspect_notion
tools.description: Introspect a Notion database: property types, relations, rollups, select options. Requires sdc-agents-smb[notion].

datasource_name.description: Name of a configured Notion datasource

tools.name: sdc_detect_drift
tools.description: Detect schema drift by comparing current datasource structure against cached previous introspection. Reports added/removed columns, type changes, nullability changes.

datasource_name.description: Name of a configured datasource (any type)

tools.name: sdc_validate_batch
tools.description: Validate all XML instances in the output directory against their SDC4 schemas via the VaaS API. Optionally sign and package.

tools.name: sdc_distribute_batch
tools.description: Distribute all validated artifact packages to configured destinations (Fuseki, Neo4j, REST APIs, filesystem).

tools.name: sdc_download_package
tools.description: Download a published data model's artifact package (.zip) containing XSD, XML, JSON, JSON-LD, HTML, and SHA1.

dm_ct_id.description: The ct_id of the published data model

tools.name: sdc_audit_summary
tools.description: Show recent audit log entries with optional filtering by agent, tool, and time range.

tools.name: sdc_compliance_report
tools.description: Generate a compliance report from audit and lineage logs: data access summary, tool invocations, credential access, data flows, validation results.

format.description: Output format: json, markdown, or html (default: markdown)
